title: Trespass to vessel; penalty.
bodyText: Whoever, without right, boards or remains in or upon any vessel of another within the waters of the State shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
bodyHtml: [§200-62]  Trespass to vessel; penalty.  Whoever, without right, boards or remains in or upon any vessel of another within the waters of the State shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. [L 1991, c 272, pt of §2]
